      public PaginatedSearchResult searchRoomsPaginated(FilterCriteriaDTO criteria, int pageIndex, int pageSize)
      Searches for rooms based on the given filter criteria with pagination support.
      Parameter:
      criteria - The filter criteria to search rooms.
      pageIndex - The page number to retrieve (0-based).
      pageSize - The number of results per page.
      Gibt zurück:
      PaginatedSearchResult containing the search results with pagination metadata.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Shutdown the controller and its background executor. Call this when the controller is no longer needed (e.g., application shutdown) to free threads.
